quote: We employ Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK) as our metric for scoring both OVERALL QUALITY and the traits ... We also report Pearson Correlation Coefficient, Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE).
To ensure consistency in scoring, each essay in ICLE++ was graded by two different annotators. Discrepancies were resolved through open discussion.
guideline: Annotators were instructed to score each essay on a set of 10 traits using the provided rubrics, then assign an overall holistic quality score.
